<!--
  A sign-in, sign-up or password reset card: heading, one sentence, the fields of the mode, a submit button,
  optional alternative sign-in buttons and a link to the other mode. Axes: mode (signin, signup, reset), layout
  (card, plain), social (none, show).
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { AuthLabels } from "./auth-card.types";

  export type AuthCardProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    text: string;
    submit: string;
    switchText: string;
    switchLink: string;
    switchHref?: string;
    labels: AuthLabels;
    mode?: "signin" | "signup" | "reset" | "magic";
    layout?: "card" | "plain";
    social?: "none" | "show" | "first";
    level?: 1 | 2;
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Block from "../primitives/block/block.svelte";
  import Button from "../primitives/button/button.svelte";
  import Group from "../primitives/group/group.svelte";
  import Link from "../primitives/link/link.svelte";
  import LucideIcon from "../primitives/lucide-icon/lucide-icon.svelte";
  import Separator from "../primitives/separator/separator.svelte";
  import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../primitives/text/text.svelte";
  import Title from "../primitives/title/title.svelte";
  import AuthForm from "../components/auth-form.svelte";
  import { cn, tpl } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    text,
    submit,
    switchText,
    switchLink,
    switchHref,
    labels,
    mode = "signin",
    layout = "card",
    social = "none",
    level = 2,
    landmarkLabel,
  }: AuthCardProps = $props();
</script>

<Block
  tag="section"
  class={cn(
    "flex w-full flex-col gap-6",
    (((layout as string) === "card") ? "rounded bg-card p-6 inset-ring inset-ring-border" : "")
  )}
  aria-labelledby={(landmarkLabel ? undefined : tpl("{0}-title", id))}
  data-testid="auth-card"
  data-mode={mode}
  aria-label={landmarkLabel}
>
  <Stack gap="2">
    <Title as={level} size="2xl" weight="bold" id={tpl("{0}-title", id)}>
      {title}
    </Title>
    <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
      {text}
    </Text>
  </Stack>
  {#if (((social as string) === "first") && ((social as string) !== "none") && ((mode as string) !== "reset") && ((mode as string) !== "magic"))}
    <Stack gap="4" data-testid="social">
      <Group gap="4" align="center">
        <Separator class="flex-1" />
        <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
          {labels.divider}
        </Text>
        <Separator class="flex-1" />
      </Group>
      <Button variant="outline" size="default" type="button" class="w-full">
        <LucideIcon name="key-round" size={16} />
        {labels.passkey}
      </Button>
      <Button variant="outline" size="default" type="button" class="w-full">
        <LucideIcon name="mail" size={16} />
        {labels.magic}
      </Button>
    </Stack>
  {/if}
  <AuthForm id={id} mode={mode} labels={labels} submit={submit} />
  {#if (((social as string) !== "first") && ((social as string) !== "none") && ((mode as string) !== "reset") && ((mode as string) !== "magic"))}
    <Stack gap="4" data-testid="social">
      <Group gap="4" align="center">
        <Separator class="flex-1" />
        <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
          {labels.divider}
        </Text>
        <Separator class="flex-1" />
      </Group>
      <Button variant="outline" size="default" type="button" class="w-full">
        <LucideIcon name="key-round" size={16} />
        {labels.passkey}
      </Button>
      <Button variant="outline" size="default" type="button" class="w-full">
        <LucideIcon name="mail" size={16} />
        {labels.magic}
      </Button>
    </Stack>
  {/if}
  <Text size="sm" class="text-center text-muted-foreground">
    {switchText}
    {" "}
    <Link href={switchHref} variant="default" data-testid="switch">
      {switchLink}
    </Link>
  </Text>
</Block>
